rule.form: Frozen parent versus frozen parent plus exactly ONE component.
rule.one_at_a_time: No kitchen-sink candidate. A component that only helps in combination with another untested change has not been measured.
rule.rejection: Reject non-repeatable improvements. An improvement that appears in one window and not in an independent one is noise until shown otherwise.
acceptance_requires: the parent passes every kill gate
the parent-plus-component passes every kill gate
the difference is measured on the same bars, not merely on the same window label
the direction of the difference repeats across independent sub-windows
the component's value is stated on the axis it actually moves, which is not always return

ablations.component: one-sided perpetual-funding froth filter: skip entries when the trailing-180-day percentile of 3-day mean funding exceeds 55
ablations.question: Does the funding filter add anything once the EMA timing it sits on top of is held fixed?
ablations.upstream_claim_being_tested: Upstream states the rule buys drawdown, not return: +1,353% at -49.4% drawdown becomes +1,604% at -33.8%, and 6 of 6 independent checks showed reduced drawdown.
ablations.why_that_axis: Upstream itself frames the component as a drawdown tool. Judging it on return would be testing a claim nobody made, and would let a return improvement that is really noise count as a win.
prerequisites: the data.binance.vision futures/um fundingRate archive route is proven in CI and passes every equivalence check
FUNDING_TIMESTAMP_KNOWABILITY is discharged per observation as funding_available_at <= signal_decision_time
both sides run with their params files loaded, so the filter threshold is 55 and not the .py default of 90
at least 1300 valid completed 1h startup candles precede the first scored Development candle, supplied by the immutable warm-up overlay
ablations.kill_condition: If the funding series cannot be acquired with provably knowable timestamps, this ablation is not run and H2 is recorded as NOT_MEASURABLE. It is not approximated with a substitute series: a different settlement convention would silently change the component being tested.
ablations.upstream_self_reported_weakness: Upstream reports the sign of the funding signal flipped in 2023. A component whose direction reverses mid-sample is a prime candidate for regime dependence, so per-regime attribution is required, not optional.

sensitivities.question: Does the funding increment survive if every funding value is held back a further full hour beyond its native availability?
sensitivities.method: re-run H2 with the funding series shifted one 1h bar later than native timing
sensitivities.record: separate experiment record; never merged with the native-timing record
sensitivities.purpose: robustness against any residual uncertainty in publication timing, not a correction to the native run
sensitivities.rule: Native timing is the reproduction. Delayed timing is a stress test. A disagreement between them is reported, not resolved by preferring one.

sensitivities.question: Does the increment hold once the funding percentile has a full 180-day trailing history rather than its 30-day minimum?
sensitivities.method: report H2 restricted to bars at which the rolling(24*180) percentile is fully populated, alongside the unrestricted native run
sensitivities.purpose: the percentile is computed from min_periods=24*30 onward, so early bars use a feature built on a thinner window than the rule intends
sensitivities.rule: Diagnostic and robustness evidence. It does NOT replace the native run and may not be substituted for it when reporting the increment.

candidate_components_not_yet_ablatable.note: Mined as hypotheses per section 13, but not registered as ablations until a parent passes its gates and the component is expressible as a single change.
from_btc_strategy_lab: EMA regime timing as a cash/exposure switch
PBO and deflated Sharpe as selection gates
parameter-sweep smoothness as an overfitting signal
from_postmortem: exit diagnostics split by exit reason

outcome_rule.accepted: component is added to a new explicitly versioned candidate, never folded silently into BASELINE-1
outcome_rule.rejected: component is recorded in the failure ledger with the measurement that rejected it
outcome_rule.no_component_survives: NEW_CANDIDATE=NO is a valid and complete result
